title: Experiment Designer
description:
A Windows desktop application for reproducible animal allocation in livestock trials, with sex composition controls, ranked body-weight subgroup balancing for RCBD, prepared pen/cage layouts, immutable history and concise Excel reports.

How to cite: If you use Experiment Designer in research, publications, reports or presentations, please cite the software version used. Author: Emmanuel O. Alagbe. Version 1.1.5 (2026), Experiment Designer [Computer software]. Use the version DOI shown on this record; the all-versions DOI is https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23698895.

This record archives source code. Download the ready-to-run Windows package and checksum from https://github.com/EhemAi/experiment-designer-app/releases/tag/v1.1.5.
